description: Tuned Delay +: the tuned delay line with a feedback path, feedback filters and a noise exciter built in, for Karplus-Strong patches

params.text: Offsets the delay pitch of both channels; type in a whole number to move it by that many octaves.
Tunes the left channel on its own, 100 cents either way.
Tunes the right channel on its own, 100 cents either way, despite the maker's tooltip naming it Fine Left Tune.
Attenuates the signal at the feedback inputs, which sets both the decay time and the timbre; by default it reaches down only to -1dB.
Sets the cutoff of the low pass filter in the feedback path as an offset in semitones from the delay pitch, so the filter tracks the note.
Sets the cutoff of the high pass filter in the feedback path as an offset in semitones from the delay pitch, so the filter tracks the note.
Blends between the filtered and unfiltered feedback signal.
Switches the low pass filter in the feedback path on.
Switches the high pass filter in the feedback path on.
Shortens the delay by a whole number of samples, from 0 to 20, to make up for the one sample each patch cable in the feedback loop adds.
Widens the feedback attenuator so it reaches down to silence.
Modulation depth for one of the four modulation inputs into the knob it belongs to; the figure is the shift a plus or minus 10V signal produces.

inputs.text: The left channel into the delay line.
The right channel into the delay line; with nothing patched here the left input feeds both channels.
Sets the delay length at 1V per octave: 1000Hz gives a delay of 1ms, 100Hz a delay of 10ms.
Returns the left output into the feedback path, saving a mixer.
Returns the right output into the feedback path, saving a mixer.
A 0-10V signal here sets the level of an internal noise generator fed into the feedback path; send it a short trigger to pluck the string.
Carries a modulation signal; arm it with its button, then turn a knob to set how far this signal moves that knob.

notes: the basic patch is V/Oct in, a trigger to the exciter input, and each output returned to the matching feedback input, with the sample correction set to 1.
A modulation input does nothing until you press the button above it to arm it and then drag a knob; the drag sets how far that input moves that knob, and a ring on the knob shows the amount.
menu: Hardclip @+/- 20V — under the heading Delay Line Limiter, hard clips the delay line at 20V either way.
Hardclip @+/- 10V — under the heading Delay Line Limiter, hard clips the delay line at 10V either way.
Hardclip @+/-  5V — under the heading Delay Line Limiter, hard clips the delay line at 5V either way.
Use Global Style — ties this module's appearance to the setting shared by every Surge XT module, rather than to this module alone.
Skin — sets the panel colouring: Dark, Medium or Light.
Colors — a submenu setting the colour of the Display Area, Knob and Slider Values, Modulations and Power Buttons, and carrying Show Knob Shadows.
Value Displays — a submenu carrying Knob Value Rings, Knob Modulation Animations and Display Modulation Animations.
